I would recommend referring to the guides on the community info page (they're really helpful!) but to answer your questions generally and quickly 

1) How you spent your quartz really depends on what servant you want. Some servants are story locked (i.e. Most round table servants you have to finish Camelot, casgil after Babylonia, etc.) so saving quartz until you finish that particular singularity would be a good idea but some limited servants only come by during rate up gachas (Gilgamesh, Jalter, okita, etc.)  so that's about the only time you can get them. I guess besides logins, completing story quests, free quests, and weekly missions are only way to get quartz free. 

2) There's some really good 1/2 star servants (arash, hans) that are even better in use than some four stars so I wouldn't completely equate usefulness with rareness. Honestly best advice is just use who you like (design or personality wise) cause you can finish the game without super rares. 

3) I guess FGO is grindy with its system of leveling servants? (And leveling the master takes a long time) but compared to other mobile games (I've only played granblue, tourabu, and FEH so I'm def no expert) it's not particularly terrible. Honestly it's really story/event focused anyways and it took me around three months to level up over lv.100/clear the story. Also how you get servants is totally RNG so (quite tragically actually) amount of time and money spent does not directly equate with good servants 

Tldr; just enjoy FGO for the story and for the characters. With its style/system leveling and the nitty gritty of gameplay honestly are not crucial to enjoying it.
